display_name: PAMF 五分支弱信道退火跨接收机与标注比例验证
scope: Receiver split 1 (F1_rx_repartition_r01), Receiver split 2 (F2_rx_repartition_r01), and 5% labeled (label05); each with seeds 2026092701/02/03. These datasets and earlier baseline predictions have been exposed, so this is an independent configuration check rather than an unexposed blind test.
initialization: For each of the nine rows, reuse that same setting and seed's actual original paper Tri-SIG-TIME E20 scratch segment. Verify identity, checkpoint payload and exact source contract, no target ancestry. Continue its own E10+E20, fixed E50. No foreign checkpoint fallback.
controls: Same setting and seed complete original Tri-SIG-TIME SSL, its frozen predictions and independent scores
same setting and seed ordinary PL, its frozen predictions and scores
evaluation: Use each protocol's original matching cached L/LU DURA and matching clean/six-practical physical observations. DURA-LU primary, DURA-L/raw secondary. All nine candidate predictions freeze before independent truth-last scoring. Report per setting, seed, scene, TX/RX/day, matched physical-ID corrections/regressions and actual sample counts. No leo_weak; no target feedback or score-selected reruns.
success: Separately for every setting, check three-seed means against Tri on clean and six-scene mean and every clean/practical mean against PL; disclose every seed/scene loss and TX/RX/day loss. Full robust claim also requires additional paired seeds and independent unexposed data.
expected_artifacts: Nine source-contract and real-checkpoint smoke records
Each setting's own E30/E50 and actual U view counters
Nine frozen seven-scene matrices with setting-specific DURA caches
Independent truth-last scoring and three-seed physical-packet paired analysis
